'''Ken'ichi Ogata''' (Japanese: '''緒方賢一''' ''Ogata Ken'ichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was born on March 29, 1942 in {{wp|Tagawa, Fukuoka}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
He began his roles with various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] during {{aniseries|OS}}. He then picked up prominent roles as [[Wattson]] and [[Charon]] in {{aniseries|RS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}, respectively.
